name: Cedar Road Playground
description: Medium sized recently refurbished site, with small skate park, floodlit ball court and teen shelter This playground is floodlit until 9.30pm Central Park Playground. At junction of Cedar and Hazel Roads, Tree Estate, next to Community Centre.
